Node.Caption: lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet01A1: Good dog, don't bark, please, I'm trying to sneak around.
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet02A3: Oh, don't you tell me you want to go with me now.
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet02A4: *sigh* First you rape me and now you all that lovey-dovey, huh?
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet02A5: Fine, just don't get in the way.
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet03A2: What, you can return back to your cave here. Although perhaps noone is waiting for you there.
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet03A3: Or you can stay here, and maybe I will come for you. One day.
lope_randonScenes01_banditDogForcegreet03A3KeepDog: Fine, you can follow me for a while.
